name: MerkleClaimAction
description: Root action. Pays cumulative Merkle allocations: each account claims what it is owed and may name another beneficiary. Records claims through the DAO, so it needs RECORD_CLAIM_PERMISSION_ID for the DAO.

inputs.name: dao
inputs.description: The installing DAO. In a recipe: DAO_REF.

inputs.name: budget
inputs.description: The flow's budget. In a recipe: ref(i) of the budget component.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: Merkle root of (account, cumulative amount) leaves, OpenZeppelin StandardMerkleTree format.
